news.title: Every Guide You'll Need for Launch: the WoW: Forever Guide Compendium
news.description: WoW: Forever launches today, and Wowhead's guides are now live! Learn everything you need to know about class changes, zones and systems, professions, dungeons, and more, all in one place.
news.details:
In just a few short hours, at 3 pm PST, WoW: Forever launches - and players will jump straight into queues to hopefully make it into Azeroth quickly! Pick your class, settle in, and take a look at our guides for everything you need to survive through launch and beyond.
What Class Should You Play in WoW: Forever?
Haven't decided what to play yet? Don't worry - we have forever to figure it out. Between the last iterations of Classic, the beta, and recent updates, though, there's plenty to look at before you make your final decision. Looking to see what the talent trees look like now? Check out our Talent Calculator - but if you want to see all the changes a class has undergone, check out our Changes tool, where you can compare the most recent build to previous builds of Forever and Anniversary.

news.details:

news.title: When Does WoW: Forever Launch Globally?
news.description: It's almost here - WoW: Forever launches today, so check out what time you'll need to log on in your time zone during this global release!
news.details:
World of Warcraft: Forever
Blizzard has told us that there will be a long maintenance today, so players have to wait a while longer before we're all able to jump into Azeroth. The maintenance is projected to end directly at launch time, but as with any launch, it may be delayed.
If all goes according to plan, however, players will be able to log in and start playing at 3 PM PST on November 4. Based on your timezone, that could be late into the night:
EST: 6 PM November 4
BRT: 8 PM November 4
GMT: 11 PM November 4
CET: 12 AM November 5
SAST: 1 AM November 5
TRT: 2 AM November 5
GST: 3 AM November 5
CST: 7 AM November 5
KST: 8 AM November 5
AEDT: 10 AM November 5
Hopefully everyone gets enough sleep ahead of time, and the launch goes smoothly - players will be experiencing a true megaserver for the first time, so prepare to make friends!

news.title: Classic Shaman Discord Open Again After 13 Hours
news.description: After almost 13 hours, the Classic Shaman Discord has reopened, allowing all players to chat in its channels once again.
news.details:
Earlier today at around 1:37 AM PST, the Classic Shaman Discord closed down, preventing players from posting in any channels. Citing "how the developers are approaching all shaman specs in WoW Forever", they listed a list of design issues that they felt were against the fundamental design and class feel of Shamans.
As of 2:28 PM PST, after almost 13 hours, the Discord is open once again and players can chat there to prepare for the WoW: Forever launch.
Doors are open again. You didn't think we'd seriously close the Discord for Forever's launch did you?
WoW: Forever launches in just over 24 hours with no listed tuning changes since the Development notes yesterday.

news.title: You Can Play WoW: Forever on a Gamepad
news.description: World of Warcraft: Forever officially supports playing with a Gamepad and Blizzard breaks down everything you need to know.
news.details:
A spell to cast, an ally to heal, a well-earned reward to collect—there’s plenty to keep you busy in Azeroth. If you prefer a gamepad, World of Warcraft: Forever gives you another way to join the action.
In World of Warcraft: Forever, we’ve refined targeting, casting, looting, and menu navigation for gamepads while keeping the familiar feel players have come to know.
Get to Know Your Gamepad Experience
WoW: Forever supports all XInput-compatible controllers and includes Xbox and PlayStation button icons to help you recognize the controls.
Switch to Gamepad Controls
Press Escape to open the Game Menu, select Options, then choose Gamepad under Gameplay to switch from keyboard-and-mouse input.
Make the experience your own in the Gamepad settings. You can adjust Camera, HUD Modifier, Frame Focus Style, Action Bars, Targeting, and Raid Targeting Options.

news.title: Tier Pieces Require Quest Chain That Requires Group Content in WoW: Forever
news.description: During the WoW: Forever Launch overview, Blizzard revealed that Tier Tokens will unlock a series of quests that ends with the player earning a Tier Piece.
news.details:
Forever Tier Set Overview
In the Forever Launch Overview video, the final section discusses raids and what to expect. Raids will once again drop Tier pieces which include bonuses for equipping multiple pieces of the same set. When talking about Tier Tokens, Blizzard revealed some details about how Tier Tokens will work.
Vanquish the raid bosses, and you'll be able to claim rewards that far exceed what you've come across previously. Acquire a Tier Token and you'll open a new adventure for you or any other ally lucky enough to claim their prize. With these rewards, you'll need to seek out how to start a quest that ends with an adventurer earning a Tier Piece, one of the greatest items one can acquire for their given class. Much like dungeons and raids, you won't be able to complete these quests completely on your own. So keep in close touch with your fellow adventurers so that you all can…

news.title: D&D: World of Warcraft Early Access Grants Pet, Mount, Decor, and Toy
news.description: The D&D: World of Warcraft bundles are now in early access, and that means players who preordered them can earn their in-game goodies for Retail WoW.
news.details:
Announced in July, the D&D: World of Warcraft bundles bring Azeroth to your Friday night games in a new way, with new rules for Warcraft classes, playable species, new spells, new monsters, and more. While the bundles officially release on November 17, early access for them begins today, so players can start to claim their in-game rewards: the Black Malice black dragon mount, the Eyestalker Beholder pet, and a Mimic-themed toy and decor!
Order D&D World of Warcraft Bundles
The lowest tier bundle to be eligible for these in-game rewards is $79.99 USD, and it's unknown whether these rewards will ever make their way to the Trading Post like previous promotional rewards have.

news.title: What's New and What's the Same in WoW: Forever
news.description: Blizzard has released a blog highlighting what's new and what will feel the same in WoW: Forever, whether you play modern, Classic or haven't played for a while.
news.details:
From a well-fought battle to a look that feels uniquely yours, the moments that matter in WoW are personal. World of Warcraft: Forever gives you another setting for those interests, whether you play the modern game, prefer Classic, haven’t logged in for a while, or are getting to know Warcraft for the first time.
If you play the modern game, some elements will feel familiar, while others take a different approach. Here’s a look at the controls, content, and character choices that can help you decide what you’d like to try.
Controls and Conveniences
Experience Presets bundle the game’s initial visual and interface settings into two options: Classic and Enhanced. The choice affects presentation, not which Ruleset you play on. Individual settings remain adjustable in Game Menu > Options.
